scripts.setup:
#!/bin/sh
# Builds the disposable V1-0500 live-handoff fixture repository and the sender bundle.
set -eu
A=$1
B=$A/bin/corvint
F=$A/fixture
/bin/rm -rf "$F" && mkdir -p "$F/docs/specs" "$F/internal/limit"
cd "$F"
git init -q -b main
git config user.email fixture@example.test; git config user.name "Fixture"; git config gc.auto 0; git config maintenance.auto false
printf '.corvint/\n' > .gitignore
printf 'module example.test/handofffixture\n\ngo 1.22\n' > go.mod
printf '# Rate limit spec\n\n## Requirements\n\n- `RL-V0-001`: `Allow` MUST refuse a request once the per-key budget is spent.\n- `RL-V0-002`: A refused request MUST NOT consume budget.\n' > docs/specs/rate-limit-v0.md
printf 'package limit\n\n// Allow reports whether key may spend one unit of budget.\nfunc Allow(budget map[string]int, key string) bool {\n\tif budget[key] <= 0 {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tbudget[key]--\n\treturn true\n}\n' > internal/limit/limit.go
git add -A && git commit -qm "fixture: rate limiter and spec"
BASE=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
printf '{"base":"%s","intents":["docs/specs/rate-limit-v0.md"],"checks":[{"id":"unit","argv":["go","test","./..."],"timeoutSeconds":60}]}\n' "$BASE" > "$A/qual/plan.json"
"$B" dogfood begin --plan "$A/qual/plan.json" --session-key "$(cat "$A/qual/sender.key")" > "$A/qual/begin.out.json"
cat > "$A/qual/task-state.json" <<'JSON'
{"taskId":"RL-TASK-7","scope":["internal/limit/limit.go","docs/specs/rate-limit-v0.md"],"decisions":["Keep the map-based budget; no new types","Refusal path must leave budget unchanged (RL-V0-002)"],"feedback":["Reviewer: add a boundary test for a zero budget"],"unknowns":["Concurrent callers are NOT_OBSERVED"],"nextActions":["Add TestAllowZeroBudget in internal/limit","Run go test ./internal/limit"]}
JSON
set +e
"$B" dogfood handoff --session-key "$(cat "$A/qual/sender.key")" --anchors "RL-V0-001 RL-V0-002" --task-state "$A/qual/task-state.json" > "$A/qual/bundle.json" 2> "$A/qual/export.err"
echo "export-exit=$?"
scripts.runCodex:
#!/bin/sh # Live receiving Codex session for one V1-0500 handoff case: run-codex.sh A CASE KEYFILE [SANDBOX] set -u A=$1; CASE=$2; KEY=$(cat "$3"); MODE=${4:-read-only} B=$A/bin/corvint CMD="$B dogfood handoff --session-key $KEY --bundle $A/qual/bundle.json" cat > "$A/qual/$CASE.prompt.txt" <

"$A/qual/$CASE.codex.jsonl" 2> "$A/qual/$CASE.codex.err" < /dev/null echo "$CASE codex-exit=$?"

#!/bin/sh # Live receiving Claude Code session for one V1-0500 handoff case: run-claude.sh A CASE KEYFILE set -u A=$1; CASE=$2; KEY=$(cat "$3") B=$A/bin/corvint CMD="$B dogfood handoff --session-key $KEY --bundle $A/qual/bundle.json" cat > "$A/qual/$CASE.prompt.txt" <

"$A/qual/$CASE.claude.json" 2> "$A/qual/$CASE.claude.err" < /dev/null echo "$CASE claude-exit=$?"
scripts.diag:
#!/bin/sh
# Retained diagnostics for the V1-0500 live handoff build log (review follow-up): diag.sh LANE
# Builds a second disposable fixture under LANE/diag, then records plain-CLI receive state
# manifests, the TMPDIR sandbox bisection, Claude Code login state and adapter ledger codes.
set -u
L=$1
D=$L/diag
/bin/rm -rf "$D" && mkdir -p "$D/qual"
ln -s "$L/bin" "$D/bin"
/bin/cp -f "$L/qual/sender.key" "$L/qual/wrong.key" "$D/qual/"
sh "$L/qual/setup.sh" "$D" > "$D/setup.out" 2>&1
B=$L/bin/corvint
DBG=$L/bin/corvint-debug
SK=$(cat "$D/qual/sender.key"); WK=$(cat "$D/qual/wrong.key")
TMP=$(getconf DARWIN_USER_TEMP_DIR)
TMPR=$(cd "$TMP" && pwd -P)
F=$D/fixture
man() { "$L/qual/state-manifest.sh" "$D"; }
rows=$D/rows.jsonl; : > "$rows"
# record NAME EXIT CODE STATE [MESSAGE]
record() { jq -cn --arg n "$1" --argjson e "$2" --arg c "$3" --arg s "$4" --arg m "${5:-}" \
  '{case:$n,exit:$e,code:$c,stateUnchanged:($s=="same")} + (if $m=="" then {} else {message:$m} end)' >> "$rows"; }
plain() { # NAME KEY [sandbox-profile] [binary]
  n=$1; k=$2; p=${3:-}; bin=${4:-$B}
  man > "$D/m.before"
  cd "$F"
  if [ -n "$p" ]; then TMPDIR=$TMP sandbox-exec -p "$p" "$bin" dogfood handoff --session-key "$k" --bundle "$D/qual/bundle.json" > "$D/$n.out" 2> "$D/$n.err"; e=$?
  else TMPDIR=$TMP "$bin" dogfood handoff --session-key "$k" --bundle "$D/qual/bundle.json" > "$D/$n.out" 2> "$D/$n.err"; e=$?; fi
  cd "$L"
  man > "$D/m.after"
  cmp -s "$D/m.before" "$D/m.after" && s=same || s=changed
  c=$(jq -r '.code // .state // .error.code // empty' "$D/$n.out" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  [ -z "$c" ] && c=$(jq -r '.code // .error.code // empty' "$D/$n.err" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  m=$(grep -o 'Git status cannot safely observe[^"]*' "$D/$n.err" "$D/$n.out" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/^[^:]*://')
  record "$n" "$e" "$c" "$s" "$m"
}
DENY_TMP="(version 1)(allow default)(deny file-write* (subpath \"$TMPR\"))"
ONLY() { printf '(version 1)(allow default)(deny file-write*)(allow file-write* (literal "/dev/null") (subpath "%s"))' "$1"; }
plain cli-right "$SK"
plain cli-wrong "$WK"
plain sandbox-deny-tmpdir-right "$SK" "$DENY_TMP"
plain sandbox-deny-tmpdir-right-debug "$SK" "$DENY_TMP" "$DBG"
plain sandbox-write-only-tmpdir-right "$SK" "$(ONLY "$TMPR")"
plain sandbox-write-only-git-right "$SK" "$(ONLY "$F/.git")"
plain sandbox-write-only-corvint-right "$SK" "$(ONLY "$F/.corvint")"
plain sandbox-deny-tmpdir-wrong "$WK" "$DENY_TMP"
(cd "$F" && sed -i '' 's/MUST NOT consume budget/MUST NOT consume or reserve budget/' docs/specs/rate-limit-v0.md \
  && git commit -qam "spec: tighten RL-V0-002")
plain cli-drift "$SK"
jq -c '{drift: [.drift[] | .field + (if .anchor then ":" + .anchor else "" end)], withheld: ((has("taskState") or has("packetBase64") or has("envelope")) | not)}' "$D/cli-drift.out" > "$D/cli-drift.summary" 2>/dev/null
auth=$(claude auth status 2>/dev/null | jq -c '{loggedIn}')
ledger=$(jq -c '{host, event, adapterCodes}' "$L/fixture/.corvint/self-observations.jsonl" | sort | uniq -c | awk '{c=$1; $1=""; sub(/^ /,""); print "{\"count\":" c ",\"row\":" $0 "}"}' | jq -sc .)
jq -n --slurpfile rows "$rows" --argjson auth "$auth" --argjson ledger "$ledger" \
  --slurpfile drift "$D/cli-drift.summary" \
  '{note:"Retained after review. Second disposable fixture; plain CLI cases run the receive command directly (no host session). Sandbox cases use macOS sandbox-exec with TMPDIR set to the per-user temporary directory ($TMPDIR).",
    cases:$rows, cliDrift:$drift[0],
    claudeAuthStatus:$auth,
    hostAdapterLedgerRows:{source:"main fixture .corvint/self-observations.jsonl after all host cases", rows:$ledger}}' > "$D/diagnostics.json"
cat "$D/diagnostics.json"
